title: PeerTopologyView
description: Per-agent peer topology — household-to-household reciprocation edges + resilience cliffs. Source of truth: peer_identity_bindings (Category A) + libp2p swarm state, federated across household peers via the T26 aggregator (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

agentCid.description: Agent CID this topology view is scoped to.

edges.description: Per-household reciprocation edges from the viewer's perspective.

reciprocationCount.description: Count of households the viewer reciprocates with (top-card metric per the household-is-resilience-unit principle).

soleReplicaCidCount.description: Count of CIDs that would lose sole-replica protection if this household goes dark.

resilienceCliffs.description: Households whose disappearance would create sole-replica risk for the viewer.

freshness.description: Topology freshness — composed from edge liveness.
